dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly falcate trailing edge with a steep concave spline curve leading to a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, forming a distinct pointed vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 to 55 degrees relative to the dorsal horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured at approximately 1.1:1 base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc with a tight radius, indicating a highly pronounced melon structure.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust pixel length approximately equal to the vertical thickness of the beak base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximate 120-degree interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform teal/cyan low-polygon mesh rendering with visible geometric facets and no biological textures.
